rateLimits.note: Anonymous and registered Public API: 12 requests a second, burst 40 (requests queued beyond the rate, rejected with a 503 past the burst). Member API: 24 a second.
Anonymous API: 25k reads a day per IP address; registered Public API: 100k a day per Client ID; Member API: no quota. Past the quota, 503 for the rest of the period.

provenance.notes: Read on 2026-11-10: the API limits FAQ and the Public APIs Terms of Service: 'a limited royalty-free license to make non-commercial use of the Public APIs'; no re-use fees, no use 'in connection with any revenue-generating product or service' (commercial use goes through the paid Member API: contract); no continuous polling of the Registry; posted limits and quotas must not be exceeded; ORCID's name not to suggest endorsement. No licence for the record data is stated on those pages (only the website text is CC0); caching and storage not addressed. This package calls pub.orcid.org anonymously (no token).
